qa: No, it can't. A rule check will occur before the played Digimon's [On Play] effect activates. A Digimon with 0 DP will be deleted upon a rule check, therefore the effect can't activate because the played Digimon is deleted and the card leaves its current area before its effect that's pending activation activates.

text_sections.text: ＜Barrier＞ [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing your top security card, all of your opponent's Digimon get -6000 DP for the turn. [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your security stack is removed from, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ until your turn ends. Then, if you have 3 or fewer security cards, ＜Recovery +1 ≪Deck≫＞.
